ideas.title: I swallow what I hit
ideas.idea: I turn into clear jelly. Fling me (or let me bounce off on my own) and whatever I splat into gets swallowed: a pumpkin, a fish, a startled Pinchy end up floating inside my see-through body, slowly turning, lit through the jelly, while I wobble around carrying them, looking guilty. A big hiccup spits them out again in a slimy arc.
ideas.form: Lumi's own body becomes a translucent jelly in the path tracer (refractive, tinted, things visibly inside it) with real squash and splat on contact; a traced film of me swallowing three things and hiccuping one onto a friend's head

ideas.title: Fling me harder and there are more of me
ideas.idea: A hard fling splits me on impact into two smaller jelly Lumis, each with half a face, that wobble off in different directions looking for each other. Fling one of them again and there are four. They sing in thirds, and when two meet they slurp back together with a jiggle.
ideas.form: soft splitting and merging of my own body as a toy + a traced film where the island fills with small Lumis and they merge back
